member.summary: A runtime kill switch an admin flips from the management endpoints. When is false the feature behind is disabled for everyone: the endpoints marked with that key answer HTTP 503 before their action runs (e.g. an expensive or paid integration is switched off while a quota is hit). member.name: T:Milvonion.Domain.IdempotencyKey
member.summary: One client-supplied idempotency key: "this user already sent this create request". A retry of the same action (double tap, a request the network lost, the client's single retry after a token refresh) carries the same Idempotency-Key header, hits the same row and gets the first attempt's response back instead of creating a second record. Rows are short lived: IdempotencyKeyCleanerJob prunes them, so the table stays small and hot.
member.remarks: The primary key is (UserId, Key): a key is only ever valid for the caller that minted it, so one user can never consume another's. pins the key to the request it was first used with; the same key with a different body is rejected instead of silently replaying the wrong response.
